terra.problem: The joke about framing the divorce certificate makes light of the serious judgment described in the verse.
The explanation quotes God speaking as “I” before identifying Him as the speaker.
Papa says he pretended he wasn't worn out in the drawer. His backstory says he knew his edges were worn and his stamps had become blurry.
The verse says they will no longer follow the stubbornness of their hearts. It does not say stubbornness will stop following them.
Calling the detestable idols “clutter” makes light of the serious sin addressed in the passage.
The verse says “the nations” will be blessed; it does not specify all nations.
The verse says no one will extinguish the fire. It does not say that the fire cannot eventually pass.
Saying the fire does not fade goes beyond the warning that no one will extinguish it.
